judgment_text:
Prayer : Sub application filed under Section 151 CPC, to grant extension of time for a period of 2 weeks with effect to comply with the directions of this Court in Sub Application No. 75 of 2026 in Cont.P. No. 3802 of 2025 order dated 23-1-2026

ORDER

This sub application has been filed to grant extension of time to comply with the directions issued by this Court in Sub. Appln. No. 75 of 2026 in Cont.P. No. 3802 of 2025 by order dated 23-1-2026.

2. Mr Ramanlal, learned Additional Advocate General submitted that Demand Draft is ready and that the same will be deposited next week.

3. Considering the submission made on either side, this sub application is allowed and time is extended till 6-3-2026.
